title: What makes a good special teams coordinator?
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: You read that right, TAFS listener, we’re talking special teams on today’s episode. Also, running back age vs wear and tear, what we would do as NFL Commissioner for a day, our favorite teams with losing records, the “Kyle Orton” tier of quarterbacks, and much more.
